propositions: Implement mcp autodeploy target with blue-green pointer-swap mechanism to track origin/main without killing in-flight certified operations (bug 7b4a)
Pre-check available memory against MCP_MEM_MIN_MB threshold; abort deploy with AUTODEPLOY_MCP_MEM_ABORT if insufficient, preventing second container startup
Atomically flip nginx /mcp/ upstream by backing up config, writing new port to temp dotfile, and using mv (atomic rename) to /etc/nginx/mcp-upstream.conf with reload
Retire old container via graceful docker stop (SIGTERM) with configured drain timeout, never SIGKILL, allowing in-flight operations to complete before container removal
Emit AUTODEPLOY_MCP_RETIRE_CAP when managed container count exceeds MCP_RELEASES_CAP (default 3) or both blue/green ports exhausted, preventing forced kills and port collisions
Detect changes only in MCP_PATHS (src/rebar, Dockerfile.mcp, docker-compose.yml, uv.lock, pyproject.toml); shared src/rebar changes trigger both mcp and review-bot independently
